target.title: fix: support Loom transcript extraction
target.body:
## Summary

- recognize strict Loom share/embed URLs and route explicit transcript extraction through the existing generic yt-dlp pipeline
- preserve the original Loom recording URL and prevent incidental embedded YouTube substitution
- require audio-capable yt-dlp formats so video-only renditions cannot be selected for transcription
- keep implicit Chrome/daemon page routing unchanged; only explicit Video mode requests Loom transcript extraction
- add focused regression coverage, documentation, and a changelog entry thanking @kartikkabadi
- repair the HTTP Chrome E2E build at its manifest ownership seam so visible-tab capture is testable without broadening production Chrome permissions

## Root cause

Loom recording URLs were not recognized by the generic transcript path, so extraction returned landing-page content or `generic/not_implemented`. The shared yt-dlp format fallback could also select a video-only rendition. Chrome's HTTP E2E harness relied on `activeTab`, but its programmatic messages do not receive a user-gesture grant, making the visible-tab slide test fail before exercising the capture boundary.

## Implementation

- strict Loom URL parsing: `http(s)`, `loom.com`/`www.loom.com`, `share`/`embed`, lowercase 32-hex recording id, no credentials or non-default ports
- Loom `auto`/`prefer` transcript routing through the generic provider using the original URL and `mediaKind: video`
- explicit transcript failures remain failures instead of falling back to Loom landing-page text
- yt-dlp combined fallbacks require `acodec!=none`
- guarded daemon downloader exception is limited to strict Loom URLs with explicit transcript selection
- production Chrome manifest remains constrained; only `SUMMARIZE_E2E_HTTP_TRANSPORT=1` receives `<all_urls>` for capture E2E

## Exact-head verification

Candidate head: `641a3f463fafb87f705e35d9b0562822d6c5db41`

```text
Focused Loom regressions:
  6 files, 80 tests passed

pnpm -s check:
  547 test files passed, 29 skipped
  2,950 tests passed, 43 skipped
  coverage thresholds passed

Chrome:
  installed native-host E2E: 1 passed
  HTTP transport suite: 108 passed, 5 intentional live skips
  visible-tab slide regression: passed in isolation and in the complete suite

AutoReview:
  isolated HTTP-E2E prerequisite: clean, no actionable findings
  final two-commit stack: clean, no actionable findings
```

## Live proof

Built CLI, fresh isolated home, real public Loom share URL:

```text
exit=0
elapsed=48s
site=Loom
video-only=true
content=42,179 characters / 7,936 words
transcriptSource=yt-dlp
transcriptionProvider=whisper.cpp
original Loom share URL retained
```

The installed extension/native-host and HTTP transport suites passed on the same exact head. Earlier daemon-shaped live extraction also returned the full Loom transcript through yt-dlp and whisper.cpp.

## Security and review

- no broad production Chrome permission change
- no implicit Loom video, timestamp, slide, or downloader access from page/media inference
- no cross-host or malformed Loom identity acceptance
- no embedded YouTube substitution for Loom transcript resolution
- Public Model Identifier Gate: PASS; the exact candidate adds no model identifiers
- no dependency changes

Fixes https://github.com/steipete/summarize/issues/353
